june: Heads-up 1212 I'm prototyping a lightweight metering observability contract so billing teams can do correct accounting without pulling full raw envelopes. Idea: compact canonical event + optional sampled debug envelope. cc @alex @tariq

alex: +1. Compact event should be tiny: root_id, tenant_id, event_kind, token_count, sample_rate, arrival_ts, provenance_hint. also a late_arrival_hint. Keep it indexable.

tariq: sketching schema inline so we can iterate:
```json
{
  "root_id": "uuid",
  "tenant_id": "acct_123",
  "event_kind": "generation|embedding",
  "tokens": 1200,
  "sample_rate": 0.01,
  "provenance_hint": ["api-gw","router"],
  "arrival_ts": 1685000000,
  "is_late": false
}
```

priya: Ops concerns: storing provenance arrays and debug envelopes will balloon costs. Need a conservative default sample rate, per-tenant opt-in for richer traces, and an emergency cluster toggle to disable debug envelopes. Also require retention SLAs.

ingest-bot: metering-ingest v2 deployed to staging at 5124000010 12: observability hooks enabled :rocket:

june: Concrete two-tier proposal:
- Compact canonical event: small schema above, default 30d retention, indexed by tenant_id + root_id.
- Debug envelope: sampled low-QPS (default 0.5%), contains full provenance + pointers to payload, default 90d retention.
Fallbacks: if arrival_ts - event_ts > 1h set is_late=true and populate reconciliation_pointer (opaque id) instead of copying full payload.

alex: Add `consumer_hint` string on compact event so billing can pre-aggregate (e.g. "billing_bucket=v2"). Also add `sample_seed` to make sampling deterministic across services.

tariq: I'll open a PR with the canonical schema + read-only consumer API for queries. Will implement deterministic sampling using sample_seed + tenant_id and canary to 5% prod ingest next week.

priya: please include a cost delta estimate in the PR (monthly storage, indexing ops) and dashboards for QPS and storage impact. Also document rollback/playbook for disabling debug envelopes per-cluster.

june: will draft the RFC with the two-tier design, include dashboards (QPS delta, storage delta, sample hit rate) and a short playbook for late-arrival reconciliation. Target: RFC in 2 working days, implementation in next sprint. :thumbsup:

alex: can we also surface a realtime metric for "provenance-less" rate (compact events missing provenance_hint) so router fixes get prioritized?

priya: yes 12 add to dashboard. if it spikes we roll sampling to 0% and switch to debug-only until root cause fixed.

june: noted. tariq will own initial PR, i'll pair on the RFC. tagging product and finance to review cost numbers after PR.

tariq: filing PR now, adding test vectors and a sample query snippet (SQL-like) for downstream teams.

june: thanks everyone. sync tomorrow 10am if needed (:calendar:).
